newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks track rising bonds to end higher.
newsitem.headline: French stocks track rising bonds to end higher.

text.p: French stocks finished higher on Monday, helped by firmer bond prices and good corporate results.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index closed up 15.55 points, or 0.78 percent, at 2,020.30, while the CAC-40 September futures contract closed six points higher at 2,022.50.
Shares in Eurotunnel rallied 3.18 percent to close at 8.10 francs after reporting an operating breakeven for the first half of 1996.
Shares in Italian industrialist Carlo De Benedetti's French holding company Cerus jumped 17 francs to 135.80 on reports that it was in buyout negotiations with French company CGIP.
The reports suggested the deal was being engineered in such a way as to avoid a takeover bid for car parts manufacturer Valeo, in which Cerus holds 28 percent. Valeo shares slumped 3.5 percent.
